user.title: Follow a trade
user.description: Find the craftsmen of a trade around your home or another place, using the public data of the Carte des artisans (cartedesartisans.fr, an independent site, not affiliated with Insee nor with the chambers of trades). Your location never leaves Home Assistant.

chercher_artisan.name: Find a craftsman
chercher_artisan.description: Finds craftsmen of a trade (plumber, electrician, locksmith, baker…) around the home, or around given coordinates, using the Carte des artisans (France). Certified businesses (RGE, EPV, Master craftsman) come first, then the closest. Returns the number found and the first ones with their phone number when known, address, distance and links.

metier.name: Trade
metier.description: Trade to search, in French as named on the site (for example “Plombier”, “Électricien”, “Serrurier”), or its key such as “maison-depannage.plombier”. Case and accents are ignored.

labellises.name: Certified only
labellises.description: Only businesses holding the RGE, EPV or Master craftsman label.

latitude.name: Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude of the search point (together with longitude). Default: the home.

longitude.name: Longitude
longitude.description: Longitude of the search point (together with latitude). Default: the home.

nombre.name: Number of results
nombre.description: Maximum number of craftsmen returned (1 to 50, default 5).

rubrique_inconnue.title: Trade removed from the Carte des artisans
rubrique_inconnue.description: The trade followed by “{entree}” ({rubrique}) no longer exists on the Carte des artisans. Delete this entry and add the trade again under its new name.
